theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_closure_and_boundary_rectifiability
theorems.statement: (∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U d) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + boundaryMassOn (Ts j) W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) ∧ (∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity R → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → R.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → IsIntegerMultiplicity R.boundary)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
